Definition: neuter of a derivative of G2776; a principal thing, i.e. main point; specially, an amount (of money):--sum.
BiblicalUsage: Kephalaion means the main point, the sum, or the sum of money. Acts 22:28 has the chief captain saying, with a great sum obtained I this freedom, and Hebrews 8:1 says, now of the things which we have spoken this is the sum: we have such an high priest.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the sum of it all is the priest: everything else adds up to him.
